messages:
pagerbot: [ALERT] Shadowcopy-forwarder detected. High-rate external S3 PUTs containing auth header fragments. 152 PUTs in last 7m. Please investigate immediately.

sam_dev: oncall? staging or prod? any customer impact?

pagerbot: env=prod, svc=inference-proxy-sidecar (shadowcopy-forwarder), src=10.14.9.23, bucket=external-uploads.thirdparty.example. Headers include Authorization and Cookie fragments.

mike_oncall: I'm taking this. Mike (oncall) joining. Lia, can you tell if tokens look full or truncated?

lia_security: grabbing audit logs. Initial scan: most look truncated but 5 PUTs include full-looking bearer tokens (redacted). Prioritize rotating svcacct-inference.

jamie_sre: pausing the forwarder in prod: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-proxy-forwarder -n prod --replicas=0` ETA ~3m

ops-bot: network egress rule applied: block s3.amazonaws.com from ns=prod-forwarders (rule id fwd-ctl-092)

sam_dev: logs snippet (anonymized):
```
2026-03-19T14:18:22Z PUT /upload 200 src=10.14.9.23 headers='Authorization: Bearer ***REDACTED***, X-Request-ID: abc123'
2026-03-19T14:19:11Z PUT /upload 200 src=10.14.9.23 headers='Cookie: sess=***...***'
```

lia_security: recommended immediate actions: 1) rotate service account tokens for svcacct-inference, 2) revoke active sessions created in last 24h for that svcacct, 3) run artifact possession search for outbound references. I'll open the rotation runbook.

mike_oncall: rotating now. Lia, confirm whether to rotate customer-facing API keys as well or internal only?

lia_security: internal-only for now; no customer tokens confirmed yet. Treat as potential exposure though — keep support comms internal until scope done.

emily_support: I'll prepare an internal customer notice template (no external comms yet). Need affected-customer list when available.

legal-team: please preserve evidence and do not send anything externally until legal signs off. If PII or customer tokens found, we'll escalate to IR.

jamie_sre: pause complete. Forwarder pods scaled to 0 (rs-ff123). No further PUTs observed since network block.

ops-bot: egress drop confirmed. Outbound PUTs to external bucket fell to 0 within 60s.

mike_oncall: rotation done for svcacct-inference: rotated keys, updated IAM policies. KMS rotation scheduled. Pushed temporary token TTL change: TOKEN_TTL=300s for the service.

lia_security: running session revocation: `scripts/revoke_sessions --service svcacct-inference --since 24h` (in progress).

sam_dev: quick Q: how did artifacts make it to external bucket? Misconfigured deploy?

jamie_sre: initial hypothesis: sidecar env var S3_TARGET was overridden by a CI deploy job. Checking CI deploy history for ci/deploy/forwarder at ~13:55.

lia_security: collect CI artifacts and logs. If CI credentials were used to push, rotate CI deploy keys too.

mike_oncall: tagging CI team to rotate deploy key and invalidate any leaked artifacts. @ci-eng ack?

ci-eng: ack. Revoking old deploy key (dk-98321) and provisioning new key. Will update deployments with the new key. ETA ~15m.

emily_support: draft internal comms: "We detected potential leakage of service-level auth headers to an external storage bucket. The forwarder has been paused and internal keys rotated. We are assessing customer impact and will update if needed." Please review.

legal-team: hold on external comms until scope complete. Notify customers only if tokens tie to customer accounts or PII.

lia_security: search results so far: 3 objects with header payloads found. All reference svcacct-inference. No customer IDs or PII observed in those objects. Continuing deeper scan.

mike_oncall: next actions: 1) confirm CI root cause, 2) complete postmortem timeline, 3) restore forwarder with safe config validation, 4) rotate any remaining keys, 5) contact customers if necessary. Setting incident severity P2.

sam_dev: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secret-exposure-rotate

jamie_sre: will re-deploy forwarder behind a config allowlist and add server-side validation that rejects S3 targets not in our allowlist. Patching helm chart now.

lia_security: scheduling 1-hour post-incident review at 19:00 UTC. Mike, Jamie, Sam, Lia, Emily, Legal please confirm.

mike_oncall: I'll lead. :thumbsup:

emily_support: I'll prepare the customer impact matrix and comms drafts.

legal-team: standing by.

pagerbot: incident update: state=mitigated; actions taken=keys rotated, forwarder paused, CI key revoked, followup=postmortem scheduled.

mike_oncall: handing off to day oncall for Monday follow-up. Assigning postmortem to @sam_dev.

sam_dev: ack. I'll own the postmortem and remediation (add config validation gate).

lia_security: evidence preserved. Exported suspect S3 objects to secure-forensics bucket. Closing channel in 2h unless new findings surface.

emily_support: note: customers to be notified only if further analysis shows customer tokens present. Otherwise internal incident note.

mike_oncall: thanks all — good triage and quick mitigation. :clap:
